title: Finite exchange after coefficient restriction
statement:
For a proper chosen Cartesian square and finite commutative coefficient ring,
apply the canonical restriction from the continuous-function coefficient modules to the
constant coefficient modules to the ambient ringed exchange. If the input carries a
finite etale-origin witness, the resulting morphism is an isomorphism.

proof.text:
Use the constants-to-functions isomorphism at each corner as the scalar-change square;
the coefficient coherence hypothesis makes both paths commute. The derived pullback and
direct-image comparison isomorphisms supplied by the ring-sheaf change-of-rings adjunction
identify the restriction of the function-coefficient ambient mate with the constant-coefficient
mate. Apply the constant-coefficient proper exchange theorem to the finite-coefficient object
realized from the retained etale complex and its canonical witness. Conjugate by the retained
witness isomorphism to obtain the component at K, then use reflection of isomorphisms by exact
restriction of scalars.
